evidence: Modifies PeerManagerImpl message handling logic in src/net_processing.cpp
rationale: Decomposes PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage into dedicated per-message handlers. The PR description notes that ProcessMessage is a '~1000-line function handling every p2p message type inline, which makes it hard to navigate and review'; this is a move-only refactoring that improves maintainability without altering protocol behavior or retiring a specific hazard.
